## What this lands

The dated-decision predicates the decision-calendar watch reads (K7 §5.2 — the P35.43 producer already reads all four ids; their absence was honest zero, now the spine produces them):

1. **Ontology: `meeting_date` (agenda) + `auto_renews` / `notice_window_days` / `renewal_term_months` (Contract).** Four `ontology/vocab/predicates.yaml` rows (registry count 281 → 285) with volatility/half-life/resolution strategy and assessed directness (`meeting_date`: edtf, MODERATE/12mo/latest_observation_wins — meetings get rescheduled; the renewal triple: IMMUTABLE/infinite/authoritative_source_wins, mirroring `renewal_options`). `Contract` gains the three LinkML slots; `make gen` artifacts committed. Recorded in **ADR-244** (`## Revisit trigger` carried).
2. **Agenda normaliser emits `meeting_date` as a claim.** The platform's own record carried the date in the `introduced` fields but never as a claim; the same reviewed alias set now emits on the `agenda_item` subject — ISO date typed, platform literal `raw_value`, unparseable literal emits `value: null` never a coerced date.
3. **Parser layer extracts renewal clauses from captured contracts (P07.1).** `parsing.renewals` — a deterministic regexp reader over the reviewed, versioned `renewal_clauses.toml` pattern set (§20): every value a verbatim slice, byte-range/page located (SIG-PARSE-003/004); years convert at exactly 12 months while a month-stated window stays unstated; a negated clause governs its own span while genuinely disagreeing clauses both record (§3.1). Wired at the one point a captured document already maps to a contract subject — the agenda-document path for contract-kind matters — under the same Part VIII forbidden-token guard as `content_term` literals (P35.28(S2)).
4. **The §11.11 Contract surface carries the stated triple** (`auto_renews: false` is a stated value, not an absence), and all four ids join the procurement predicate allowlist (SIG-INGEST-033).
5. **Supersession is recorded append-only.** A moved meeting or restated renewal term lands as a NEW claim row; the `revises_claim`/`retraction_of` pair and the producer's `_latest` ordering drive the watch item's `status: superseded` — never an UPDATE/DELETE (SIG-STORE-011).
